sourceSnapshot.playerHelp.title: Welcome to Foundation Event Organizer
sourceSnapshot.playerHelp.subtitle: This is where your guild signs up for events — Shadowfront matches, scrims, and anything else the leadership wants on the calendar.
sourceSnapshot.playerHelp.gettingIn.step1: Sign in with Google or Discord on the home page.
sourceSnapshot.playerHelp.gettingIn.step2: Join your guild. Most people get in via an invite link from a guild admin. You can also browse public guilds at the <discoveryLink>discovery page</discoveryLink>.
sourceSnapshot.playerHelp.gettingIn.step3: Once you're in a guild, the home page shows that guild's upcoming events.
sourceSnapshot.playerHelp.gettingIn.note: You can only be in one guild at a time. To move, leave the current one first.
sourceSnapshot.playerHelp.eventKinds.match: Match events (Shadowfront and similar) — two squads, each with their own start time, leadership slots, and a starting roster plus backups.
sourceSnapshot.playerHelp.eventKinds.scrim: Scrim events — a 1-vs-1 challenge between your guild and another guild. Single squad, one start time, and a declared winner when it's over. See the Scrimmage events section below.
sourceSnapshot.playerHelp.eventKinds.simple: Simple events — info-only entries on the calendar (a meeting, an announcement, a watch party). No signup form; just a date and details.
sourceSnapshot.playerHelp.signup.intro: Open the event from the home page. The signup form has three things:
sourceSnapshot.playerHelp.signup.step1: Squad preference (first choice). Pick the squad you most want to play on. If your first choice is full, admins try to place you on the other.
sourceSnapshot.playerHelp.signup.step2: Willing to be a backup. On by default. Backups fill in when a starter drops. Uncheck this if you only want to play with a guaranteed starting slot.
sourceSnapshot.playerHelp.signup.step3: Request a leadership position (optional). Leaders coordinate the squad during the match. Admins assign leaders from the requests; you can leave a short note about why you'd like the role.
sourceSnapshot.playerHelp.signup.submit: Hit Sign Up. You can come back and change any of these answers up until signups close.
sourceSnapshot.playerHelp.status.intro: When you look at the squad rosters, you'll see one of these next to each name:
sourceSnapshot.playerHelp.status.backup: Backup — on the backup roster; plays only if a starter drops.
sourceSnapshot.playerHelp.status.leader: Leader — chosen by an admin to lead the squad.
sourceSnapshot.playerHelp.status.waitlist: Waitlist — all squad and backup slots were full when you signed up. You're promoted automatically if someone drops.
sourceSnapshot.playerHelp.status.wantsLeader: Wants Leader — a player who asked for the role; an admin will pick from these.
sourceSnapshot.playerHelp.scrims.intro: A scrim is your guild against another guild. The event page works the same as a match — sign up, pick backup willingness, optionally request leadership — but with a few differences worth knowing:
sourceSnapshot.playerHelp.scrims.oneSquad: One squad only. There's no Squad 1 vs Squad 2 pick — your guild fields a single lineup against the opponent.
sourceSnapshot.playerHelp.scrims.opponent: The opponent is shown at the top of the event page, along with the Condition of Win the two admins agreed on. Read it before the match — it's how the winner gets determined.
sourceSnapshot.playerHelp.scrims.result: Result chip. Once the match is done and an admin declares the result, you'll see a colored chip on the event page: Won, Lost, Draw, or No contest (for forfeits or disconnects).
sourceSnapshot.playerHelp.scrims.history: History. See your guild's upcoming and past scrims on the <scrimsLink>scrim history page</scrimsLink>. W/L is from your guild's perspective.
sourceSnapshot.playerHelp.scrims.note: Only your guild's admin can propose, accept, or cancel a scrim — you just sign up like any other event. If a scrim is cancelled before it happens, the event disappears from your home page and your signup is hidden (admins still keep the record for attendance history).
sourceSnapshot.playerHelp.reminders.bot: If your guild has the Discord bot set up, the bot posts reminders 1 day, 1 hour, and 20 minutes before each event in your guild's chosen channel.
sourceSnapshot.playerHelp.reminders.ics: Every event page has a Download .ics link for adding the event to your calendar.
sourceSnapshot.playerHelp.reminders.slashCommands: Discord slash commands: /upcoming lists your guild's upcoming events, and /signup lets you sign up without leaving Discord. You have to sign in to the website with Discord at least once first, so the bot can match your account.
sourceSnapshot.playerHelp.closed: The form turns into a "Signups are closed" message. Reach out to a guild admin if you need to be added late — they can adjust signups manually.
